# Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-ṭīkā (Tika S0201t)

**ID:** Tika S0201t

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-ṭīkā* is the Pali subcommentary (ṭīkā) on the *Mūlapaṇṇāsa*, the first collection of fifty discourses of the *Majjhimanikāya* [PA_tika-s02_01t catalog]. In modern scholarship, Andrea Schlosser notes the work's opening exegetical section, the *Ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā*, when examining conventional commentary phrasing (*sesaṃ yonisomanasikāre vuttavipariyāyena veditabba[ṃ]*) in comparative relation to Gāndhārī manuscripts and other Pali commentaries [Schlosser 2016].

Text-reuse analysis conducted by DharmaNexus records extensive Pali-internal overlap, identifying 95,410 matching passages distributed across 509 other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. Naturally, the subcommentary shares extensive textual material with its base commentary, the *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā* (4,452 matches, longest §240_2–240_8 ↔ §2264_2–2264_8) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits high degrees of shared text with other subcommentarial and scholastic works, particularly the *Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭīkā* (2,369 matches, longest §0–55_0 ↔ §0–53_0), the *Dīghanikāye Mahāvaggaṭīkā* (2,468 matches), the *Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-ṭīkā* (1,517 matches), the *Saṃyuttanikāye Sagāthāvaggaṭīkā* (1,797 matches), and both volumes of the *Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language alignments reach the threshold score in DharmaNexus [DharmaNexus].

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭīkā (Tika S0101t) (§0–55_0 ↔ §0–53_0); Dīghanikāye Mahāvaggaṭīkā (Tika S0102t) (§1071_4–1089_5 ↔ §1218_7–1236_5); Aṅguttaranikāye Ekakanipāta-ṭīkā (Tika S0401t) (§17_2–61_1 ↔ §74_1–117_1); Saṃyuttanikāye Sagāthāvaggaṭīkā (Tika S0301t) (§91_7–155 ↔ §81_6–145); Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaabhinavaṭīkā (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Tika S0104t) (§34_0–43_0 ↔ §77_2–84_0); Aṅguttaranikāye Dukanipāta-ṭīkā (Tika S0402t) (§760_1–771_6 ↔ §72_3–86_6); Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0201a) (§240_2–240_8 ↔ §2264_2–2264_8); Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Anya E0103n) (§119_3–142_2 ↔ §888_2–911_2)
